translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.96:1: Read, ˹O Prophet,˺ in the Name of your Lord Who created—
verses.96:2: created humans from a clinging clot
verses.96:3: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous
verses.96:5: taught humanity what they knew not
verses.96:6: Most certainly, one exceeds all bounds
verses.96:7: once they think they are self-sufficient
verses.96:8: ˹But˺ surely to your Lord is the return ˹of all˺
verses.96:9: Have you seen the man who prevents
verses.96:13: What if that ˹man˺ persists in denial and turns away
verses.96:14: Does he not know that Allah sees ˹all˺
verses.96:15: But no! If he does not desist, We will certainly drag him by the forelock—
verses.96:17: So let him call his associates
verses.96:18: We will call the wardens of Hell
verses.96:19: Again, no! Never obey him ˹O Prophet˺! Rather, ˹continue to˺ prostrate and draw near ˹to Allah˺
